# Syntax Studio

> An independent creative house in Oslo, Norway. Three specialist practices work independently and together: ISO400 (Image & Design), 35mm (Film & VFX), Nyfane (Technology).

Syntax connects image, motion and technology at the start of a project. Clients can commission one practice or bring a multidisciplinary brief to the house.

## Practices and people

- ISO400: image, photography, art direction and design. Led by co-founder Gunder Rollufson.
- 35mm: film, direction, motion and VFX. Led by co-founder Khamzat Dudaev.
- Nyfane: websites, digital products and creative technology. Led by co-founder Rasul Uzdijev.
